original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚阿南布拉州一名通缉嫌疑人因抢劫和绑架被捕
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚阿南布拉州警方在阿瓦卡北部地方政府区埃贝内贝社区开展行动，逮捕了26岁的通缉嫌疑人乌多丘库·奥卡福。警方称，初步审讯显示该嫌疑人涉嫌从一名治安人员手中抢走一支泵动式枪械。据称，他因涉嫌参与武装抢劫、绑架、邪教相关活动及分离主义相关罪行而被列入通缉名单。

location.raw_text: Ebenebe community, Awka North Local Government Area, Anambra State

key_facts.fact: 阿南布拉州警方逮捕26岁通缉嫌疑人乌多丘库·奥卡福
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Anambra State Police Command has arrested a 26-year-old wanted suspect, Udochukwu Okafor

key_facts.fact: 逮捕行动在埃贝内贝社区进行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: during an operation in Ebenebe community, Awka North Local Government Area of the state

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人被指从治安人员手中抢走一支泵动式枪械
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the suspect allegedly snatched a pump-action firearm from a vigilante operative in Ebenebe

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人因涉嫌武装抢劫、绑架、邪教及分离主义相关罪行被通缉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Okafor had been on the command’s wanted list over alleged involvement in armed robbery, kidnapping, cult-related activities and secessionist-related offences

uncertainties: 相关指控为警方初步审讯所称，尚未经法院审理确认
目前仅单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
